```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
#Import genes from WES for visualization - please see methods and "Processing Pipeline" for upstream steps.

Genes_for_heatmap <- read_rds(Genes_for_heatmap)
```
```{r}
T0_mat<- Genes_for_heatmap %>% column_to_rownames(var="Hugo_Symbol") %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(.=="",NA,as.character(.)))) %>% as.matrix()
```
```{r}
#Make matrix from genes and variants

mat_t <- t(T0_mat)

mat_t_df <- as.data.frame(mat_t)

mat_t_df$Unique_pt_id <- rownames(mat_t_df)

Patients_in_matrix <- mat_t_df$Unique_pt_id

mat_t0_hm <- t(mat_t)
```
```{r}
alter_fun = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, 
            gp = gpar(fill = "lightgrey", lwd=0.3)),
  Nonsense_Mutation = function(x, y, w, h) 
     grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#FF0000", col="black")),
   Missense_Mutation = function(x, y, w, h) 
     grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#00A08A", col="black", lwd=0.5)),
   Frame_Shift_Del = function(x, y, w, h)
     grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#F8DE7E", col="black", lwd=0.5)),
   Frame_Shift_Ins = function(x, y, w, h) 
        grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#5BBCD6", lwd=0.5)),
    In_Frame_Indel = function(x, y, w, h) 
        grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#EA879CFF", lwd=0.5)),
   Multiple_types = function(x, y, w, h) 
        grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#614051", lwd=0.5)),
    Frame_Shift_Complex = function(x, y, w, h) 
        grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "brown", lwd=0.5)),
    Splice_Site = function(x, y, w, h) 
        grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "darkorange", lwd=0.5)),
    Nonstop_Mutation = function(x, y, w, h) 
        grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "pink", lwd=0.5)))

col = c(Nonsense_Mutation = "#FF0000", Missense_Mutation = "#00A08A", Frame_Shift_Del = "#F8DE7E", Frame_Shift_Ins = "#5bbCD6", In_Frame_Indel = "#EA879CFF", Multiple_types = "#614051", Splice_Site = "darkorange")
```
```{r}
Supplementary_Tables <- read_excel("~/Desktop/MATCH_npj_PO/Tables/Supplementary_Tables.xlsx", 
+     sheet = "STable1_Patient_Information")
```
```{r}
anno <- Supplementary_Tables

 Response = anno$Response
 Time = anno$Timepoint
 Sex = anno$Sex
 Sample = anno$Tissue
 Karyotype = anno$Karyotype
 Histotype = anno$Histotype
 'TP53/Chr17 Deletion'  = anno$Del_17_TP53
 'X or Y Deletion' = anno$Del_X_Y
 GSVA_1st = anno$GSVA_1st
 GSVA_2nd = anno$GSVA_2nd
 GSVA_3rd = anno$GSVA_3rd
```
```{r}
#Row annotations are imported with another file "MCL_genes_filter.xlsx", table = "Row_annotation"

Row_annotation <- read_excel("~/Desktop/MATCH_npj_PO/MCL_MAFS_filtered/All_MCL_mutations.xlsx", 
sheet = "Row_annotation")

Pathway <- (Row_annotation$Pathway)

row = rowAnnotation(Pathway=Pathway, col=list("Pathway"=c(
"CAR-T"= '#9BB655FF',"OXPHOS"="#E46844FF","PARP"="#8FA3ABFF","PLK1"="#5480B5FF","NF-kB_Proteasome"="#834D24FF", "AKT-ERK"= "#F9F2D8FF","BTK"="#871C0FFF", "CDK" = "#894D9FFF", "mTOR" = "#F8DE7E", "Notch" = "#3FA0FFFF", 'Other_MCL'= "#FD817EFF", "PI3K_HDAC"= "#3A9387FF", "PI3K_mTOR" ="#C19A8DFF","CAR-T"= '#803233FF'), gp = gpar(col = "black"))
)
```
```{r}
ha = HeatmapAnnotation(Response = Response,
                       Sex = Sex,
                       Karyotype = Karyotype,
                       Histotype = Histotype,
                      'X or Y Deletion' = anno$Del_X_Y,
                      'TP53/Chr17 Deletion'  = anno$Del_17_TP53,
                       GSVA_1st = anno$GSVA_1st,
                       GSVA_2nd = anno$GSVA_2nd,
                       GSVA_3rd = anno$GSVA_3rd,
                       col=list(
                         'Response'=c('Non-responder'= "darkblue",'Responder'="darkgreen"),
                         'Sample'=c('Apheresis'="orange",'LN'="yellow",'BM'="blue",'PB'="red","Other"="gray"),
                         'Sex'=c('Female'="pink",'Male'="lightblue"),
                         'Time'=c('Naiive'="#67a9cf",'Relapsed'="violet","Treatment"="darkred"),
                         'Karyotype'=c("Complex"="purple","Abnormal"="blue","Normal"="green"),
                         'Histotype'=c("Blastoid"="#E5AD4FFF","Classic"="#A7DBD8FF",'Pleomorphic'="#486078FF"),
                         "GSVA_1st"=c("CAR-T"= '#9BB655FF', "HDAC"='#ED3F39FF', "MALT-1"="#ADD0B5FF", "MDM2"="#484357FF",
                                      "OXPHOS"="#E46844FF", "PARP"="#8FA3ABFF", "PI3K-Akt"="#303638FF",
                                      "PLK1"="#5480B5FF","Proteasome"="#834D24FF", "Thioredoxin Reducatase"="#F4C659FF"), 
                         "GSVA_2nd"=c("AKT/ERK"= "#F9F2D8FF","BCL-2"="#AF2213FF", "BTK"="#871C0FFF","CAR-T"= '#9BB655FF',
                                      "CDK" = "#894D9FFF","HDAC"='#ED3F39FF', "MALT-1"="#ADD0B5FF",
                                      "MDM2"="#484357FF","OXPHOS"="#E46844FF","PI3K-Akt"="#303638FF","PI3Ka"="#C19A8DFF",
                                      "PLK1"="#5480B5FF","Thioredoxin Reducatase"="#F4C659FF"),
                         "GSVA_3rd"=c("AKT/ERK"= "#F9F2D8FF","BCL-2"="#AF2213FF","CAR-T"= '#9BB655FF',
                                      "CDK" = "#894D9FFF","HDAC"='#ED3F39FF', "MALT-1"="#ADD0B5FF",
                                      "OXPHOS"="#E46844FF","PARP"= '#8FA3ABFF',"PI3K-Akt"="#303638FF", "PI3K/HDAC"= "#3A9387FF",
                                      "PI3Ka"="#C19A8DFF", "Proteasome"="#834D24FF","Thioredoxin Reducatase"="#F4C659FF")),
                       which = "column", annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8), gp = gpar(col = "black"))
```

```{r}
sample_order = c("MCL1","MCL2","MCL3","MCL4","MCL5","MCL6","MCL7","MCL8","MCL9","MCL10","MCL11","MCL12","MCL13","MCL14","MCL15","MCL16","MCL17","MCL18","MCL19","MCL20")
```

```{r}
T0_mutations = oncoPrint(mat_t0_hm, alter_fun = alter_fun, na_col = "gray",  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Variant Type"), border_gp = gpar(col="black", lty = 1), show_column_names = T, row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "italic"), row_names_side = "left", pct_side = "right", pct_gp = gpar(fontsize=10), show_pct = T, col = col, top_annotation = ha, right_annotation = row, column_order = sample_order)
```

```{r}
pdf(file = "MCL_Oncoplot.pdf", height=15, width=12)

plot(T0_mutations)

dev.off()
```
